<template>
  <v-app>
    <v-app-bar app color="primary" dark>
      <v-toolbar-title>My Vue App</v-toolbar-title>
      <v-spacer></v-spacer>
      <v-toolbar-items>
        <v-btn
          text
          :to="{ name: 'Home' }"
          :class="{ active: $route.name === 'Home' }"
          >Home</v-btn
        >
        <v-btn
          text
          :to="{ name: 'About' }"
          :class="{ active: $route.name === 'About' }"
          >About</v-btn
        >
        <v-btn
          text
          :to="{ name: 'Contact' }"
          :class="{ active: $route.name === 'Contact' }"
          >Contact</v-btn
        >
        <v-btn

          :to="{ name: 'Document' }"
          :class="{ active: $route.name === 'Document' }"
          >Document</v-btn
        >
        <v-btn
          text
          :to="{ name: 'XML Data' }"
          :class="{ active: $route.name === 'XML Data' }"
          >XML Data</v-btn
        >
      </v-toolbar-items>
    </v-app-bar>

    <v-main class="pa-4">
      <router-view />
    </v-main>
  </v-app>
</template>

<script>
import { useRoute } from "vue-router";

export default {
  setup() {
    const route = useRoute(); // Correct: Use route, not $route
    return {
      $route: route, // Now correctly assign to $route
    };
  },
};
</script>

<style scoped>
.active {
  color: yellow !important;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.v-btn--text:hover {

}
</style>
